title: A palladium complex of 2,2′-(propane-1,3-diylbis(oxy))dibenzenaminium chloride on SBA-15 as a returnable, environmental and selective nanostructured-catalyst in the Suzuki C–C coupling reaction
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21896-21907
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08145A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shirin Mohammadi, Mohsen Nikoorazm, Bahman Tahmasbi, Yunes Abbasi Tyula
Modified SBA-15 was functionalized by a new complex of palladium, and was characterized by SEM, ICP, TGA/DSC, EDS, BET/BJH, and WDX techniques. Then, its catalytic activity was investigated in the selective C–C coupling reaction.
